modules.name: Report Board Dimensions
modules.description: Report dimensions, mounting-hole offsets, and fiducial offsets for the board open in PCB Editor.

risk.summary: Reads the open board through KiCad IPC without changing it.

modules.name: Check BOM Stock
modules.description: Compare a schematic BOM with the component stock workbook and report shortages or metadata errors.

parameters.name: schematic
parameters.label: Schematic
parameters.description: Schematic to check; omit to discover the schematic open in KiCad.

parameters.name: workbook
parameters.label: Stock workbook
parameters.description: Workbook containing the stock table.

parameters.name: sheet
parameters.label: Sheet
parameters.description: Workbook sheet containing stock data.

parameters.name: minimum_stock
parameters.label: Minimum stock
parameters.description: Minimum acceptable quantity for each BOM item.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Reads project and workbook files and creates only a temporary netlist.

modules.name: Generate JLCPCB Files
modules.description: Generate fabrication Gerbers, drill data, BOM, and placement files for one KiCad project.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: Project
parameters.description: Project directory, .kicad_pro file, or .kicad_pcb file.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Creates or replaces manufacturing artifacts beneath the selected project.

modules.name: Panelize Routed PCB
modules.description: Create a routed mouse-bite production panel from a KiCad PCB.

parameters.name: input
parameters.label: Input PCB
parameters.description: Source board file.

parameters.name: count_x
parameters.label: Horizontal count
parameters.description: Number of boards across the panel.

parameters.name: count_y
parameters.label: Vertical count
parameters.description: Number of boards down the panel.

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output PCB
parameters.description: Destination panel file; parent directories may be created.

parameters.name: gap
parameters.label: Board gap
parameters.description: Routed gap between boards in millimetres.

parameters.name: rail
parameters.label: Rail width
parameters.description: Perimeter process rail in millimetres.

parameters.name: tab_width
parameters.label: Tab width
parameters.description: Breakaway-tab width in millimetres.

parameters.name: mouse_bite_diameter
parameters.label: Mouse-bite diameter
parameters.description: Mouse-bite drill diameter in millimetres.

parameters.name: mouse_bite_clearance
parameters.label: Mouse-bite clearance
parameters.description: Edge-to-edge drill clearance in millimetres.

parameters.name: force
parameters.label: Replace output
parameters.description: Allow replacement of an existing output file.

modules.name: Manufacture JLCPCB Panel
modules.description: Panelize a project and generate its complete JLCPCB fabrication and assembly package.

parameters.name: project
parameters.label: Project directory
parameters.description: Directory containing its same-named board file.

parameters.name: count_x
parameters.label: Horizontal count
parameters.description: Number of boards across the panel.

parameters.name: count_y
parameters.label: Vertical count
parameters.description: Number of boards down the panel.

parameters.name: kicad_cli
parameters.label: KiCad CLI
parameters.description: Optional validated path to the KiCad CLI executable.

risk.summary: Replaces the generated panel and manufacturing package in the project output directory.

modules.name: Center Component Between Board Edges
modules.description: Move one footprint to the midpoint of the local board-edge crossings on a selected axis.

parameters.name: reference
parameters.label: Footprint reference
parameters.description: Exact reference of the footprint to move, for example J1.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.label: Alignment axis
parameters.description: Coordinate axis along which to center the footprint.

parameters.name: include_text
parameters.label: Include footprint text
parameters.description: Include reference and value text when calculating the footprint center.

risk.summary: Moves one footprint on the open board in a single undoable PCB Editor transaction.

modules.description: Place up to four mounting-hole footprints at explicit offsets from the board edges.

parameters.label: Top-left reference
parameters.description: Top-left mounting-hole footprint reference.

parameters.name: top_right
parameters.label: Top-right reference
parameters.description: Top-right mounting-hole footprint reference.

parameters.name: bottom_left

parameters.description: Bottom-left mounting-hole footprint reference.

parameters.name: bottom_right

parameters.description: Bottom-right mounting-hole footprint reference.

parameters.name: direction

parameters.description: Coordinates to replace from the calculated targets.

parameters.name: left_offset

parameters.name: right_offset
parameters.label: Right offset

parameters.name: top_offset

modules.name: Center and Distribute Footprints
modules.description: Align selected footprint centers to the first reference and optionally distribute their spacing.

parameters.name: references
parameters.label: Footprint references
parameters.description: Ordered footprint references; the first is the alignment anchor.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Axis on which footprint centers are aligned.

parameters.name: distribute_spacing
parameters.label: Distribute spacing
parameters.description: Also distribute items on the perpendicular axis.

risk.summary: Moves every selected footprint in one undoable PCB Editor transaction.

modules.name: Center Routed Design in Board
modules.description: Translate all footprints, tracks, and vias together to center them inside Edge.Cuts.

parameters.name: include_text
parameters.label: Include footprint text
parameters.description: Include reference and value text in the design bounds.

risk.summary: Moves all footprints and routed copper together in one undoable transaction.

modules.name: Center Board Outline Around Components
modules.description: Move Edge.Cuts and board-spanning zones around the fixed component layout.

parameters.name: include_text
parameters.label: Include footprint text
parameters.description: Include reference and value text in the component bounds.

parameters.name: zone_edge_tolerance
parameters.label: Zone-edge tolerance
parameters.description: Tolerance in millimetres for identifying board-spanning zones.

risk.summary: Moves the complete board outline and matching board-spanning zones in one undoable transaction.

modules.name: Space Two Components
modules.description: Set center-to-center spacing between a fixed anchor footprint and one moving footprint.

parameters.name: anchor
parameters.label: Anchor reference
parameters.description: Footprint reference that remains fixed.

parameters.name: moving
parameters.label: Moving reference
parameters.description: Footprint reference to move.

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Axis on which to set the center spacing.

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.label: Spacing
parameters.description: Requested center-to-center spacing in millimetres.

parameters.name: include_text
parameters.label: Include footprint text
parameters.description: Include reference and value text in footprint bounds.

risk.summary: Moves one selected footprint in a single undoable PCB Editor transaction.
